title: Approval steps delay routine deliveries
summary: Routine dispatch requests wait on multiple sequential approvals, adding a day or more before goods leave the warehouse.
estimatedImpact: Delivery lead time increased by roughly a day for standard orders.

title: Core system outage halts order entry
summary: An unplanned outage of the order-management system stopped order entry for several hours with no clear status updates.
estimatedImpact: Several hours of blocked order entry across multiple teams.

title: Manual re-entry between finance systems
summary: Invoice data is re-keyed by hand between two finance systems that do not sync, causing repeated rework.
estimatedImpact: Hours of duplicate data entry each week and occasional mismatches.

title: Unclear escalation path for urgent cases
summary: Support staff are unsure who owns urgent customer cases after hours, so escalations stall.
estimatedImpact: Urgent cases occasionally wait overnight before an owner is found.

title: Field teams lack adequate equipment
summary: Field sales staff report outdated or missing equipment that slows customer visits.
estimatedImpact: Slower customer visits and occasional rescheduling.

title: Onboarding buddy program is working well
summary: New hires say the onboarding buddy program helped them ramp up faster and feel supported.
estimatedImpact: Faster ramp-up and higher reported confidence among new hires.

title: Dispatch handoffs cause confusion
summary: Handoffs between shifts lack a consistent checklist, so context and paperwork are sometimes lost.
estimatedImpact: Occasional missed paperwork and repeated work between shifts.

title: Purchase-order approvals sit too long
summary: Purchase orders wait on approvals with no visibility into who holds them up, delaying procurement.
estimatedImpact: Procurement delayed by several days on average.

title: Remote access is unstable during peak hours
summary: Remote workers report frequent VPN drops during peak hours, interrupting work.
estimatedImpact: Repeated short interruptions for remote staff during peak hours.

title: Knowledge base is outdated
summary: Support articles are out of date, so staff give inconsistent answers and rework responses.
estimatedImpact: Inconsistent customer answers and repeated follow-ups.

title: CRM data quality is inconsistent
summary: Duplicate and incomplete CRM records make it hard to trust pipeline reports.
estimatedImpact: Pipeline reports need manual cleanup before they can be trusted.

title: Cross-team ownership is unclear
summary: Work that spans teams stalls because no single team clearly owns the outcome.
estimatedImpact: Cross-team initiatives lose momentum without a clear owner.
